instruction: Write a Prometheus alert rule named InstanceDown that fires when a target is down for 5 minutes at critical severity
output:
groups:
  - name: availability
    rules:
      - alert: InstanceDown
        expr: up == 0
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: Target {{ $labels.instance }} is down
          description: Job {{ $labels.job }} has been unreachable for more than 5 minutes.

instruction: Write an alert rule named HighErrorRate that fires when the 5xx ratio exceeds 5 percent for 10 minutes
output:
groups:
  - name: errors
    rules:
      - alert: HighErrorRate
        expr: job:http_request_errors:rate5m / job:http_requests:rate5m > 0.05
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: High error rate on {{ $labels.job }}
          description: More than 5 percent of requests to job {{ $labels.job }} are returning 5xx.

instruction: Write an alert rule named HighLatencyP99 firing when p99 latency is above 1 second for 10 minutes
output:
groups:
  - name: latency
    rules:
      - alert: HighLatencyP99
        expr: job:http_request_duration_seconds:p99 > 1
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: p99 latency above 1s for {{ $labels.job }}
          description: The 99th percentile latency for {{ $labels.job }} has exceeded one second.

instruction: Write an alert rule named HighCPUUsage that fires when CPU utilisation stays above 85 percent for 15 minutes
output:
groups:
  - name: nodes
    rules:
      - alert: HighCPUUsage
        expr: instance:node_cpu_utilisation:rate5m > 0.85
        for: 15m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: High CPU on {{ $labels.instance }}
          description: CPU utilisation on {{ $labels.instance }} has been above 85 percent for 15 minutes.

instruction: Write an alert rule named MemorySaturation firing when memory utilisation exceeds 90 percent for 10 minutes
output:
groups:
  - name: nodes
    rules:
      - alert: MemorySaturation
        expr: node:memory_utilisation:ratio > 0.9
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: Memory saturation on {{ $labels.instance }}
          description: Less than 10 percent of memory is available on {{ $labels.instance }}.

instruction: Write an alert rule named DiskFillingUp that fires when root filesystem usage is above 85 percent for 15 minutes
output:
groups:
  - name: nodes

      - alert: DiskFillingUp
        expr: node:filesystem_usage:ratio > 0.85
        for: 15m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:

instruction: Write an alert rule named CertificateExpiringSoon firing when an SSL certificate expires in less than 15 days
output:
groups:
  - name: blackbox
    rules:
      - alert: CertificateExpiringSoon
        expr: probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry - time() < 15 * 24 * 3600
        for: 1h
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: Certificate for {{ $labels.instance }} expires soon
          description: The TLS certificate for {{ $labels.instance }} expires in less than 15 days.

instruction: Write an alert rule named TooManyRestarts that fires when a process restarted more than twice in an hour
output:
groups:
  - name: process
    rules:
      - alert: TooManyRestarts
        expr: changes(process_start_time_total[1h]) > 2
        for: 0m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: Process restarting frequently on {{ $labels.instance }}
          description: The process on {{ $labels.instance }} restarted more than twice in the last hour.

instruction: Write an alert rule named ScrapeTargetsDown that fires when any job has at least one down target for 5 minutes
output:
groups:
  - name: availability
    rules:
      - alert: ScrapeTargetsDown
        expr: sum by (job) (up == 0) > 0
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: Targets down in job {{ $labels.job }}
          description: At least one target in job {{ $labels.job }} has been down for 5 minutes.

instruction: Write an alert rule named NoTraffic firing when a job receives zero requests for 30 minutes
output:
groups:
  - name: traffic
    rules:
      - alert: NoTraffic
        expr: sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total[5m])) == 0
        for: 30m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: No traffic for {{ $labels.job }}
          description: Job {{ $labels.job }} has received no requests for 30 minutes.

instruction: Write an alert rule named DatabaseConnectionsHigh firing when MySQL connections exceed 200 for 5 minutes
output:
groups:
  - name: database
    rules:
      - alert: DatabaseConnectionsHigh
        expr: mysql_global_status_threads_connected > 200
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: Too many MySQL connections on {{ $labels.instance }}
          description: Thread count on {{ $labels.instance }} is above 200 and may exhaust the connection pool.

instruction: Write an alert rule named QueueBacklog firing when a queue holds more than 10000 pending messages for 10 minutes
output:
groups:
  - name: queues
    rules:
      - alert: QueueBacklog
        expr: rabbitmq_queue_messages > 10000
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: Queue backlog on {{ $labels.queue }}
          description: Queue {{ $labels.queue }} holds more than 10000 unacknowledged messages.

instruction: Write an alert rule named PodOOMKilled that fires when any container was OOM killed in the last 15 minutes
output:
groups:
  - name: kubernetes
    rules:
      - alert: PodOOMKilled
        expr: increase(container_oom_kills_total[15m]) > 0
        for: 0m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: Container OOM killed in {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.pod }}
          description: Container {{ $labels.container }} was killed by the OOM killer in namespace {{ $labels.namespace }}.

instruction: Write an alert rule named ReplicaUnavailable firing when a deployment has fewer available replicas than desired for 10 minutes
output:
groups:
  - name: kubernetes
    rules:
      - alert: ReplicaUnavailable
        expr: kube_deployment_status_replicas_available < kube_deployment_spec_replicas
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: Deployment {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.deployment }} has unavailable replicas
          description: Fewer replicas are available than the deployment spec requires.

instruction: Write an alert rule named HTTP5xxSpike firing when the global 5xx rate passes 100 requests per second
output:
groups:
  - name: errors
    rules:
      - alert: HTTP5xxSpike
        expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m])) > 100
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: 5xx spike detected
          description: The global server error rate is above 100 requests per second.

instruction: Write an alert rule named MemoryLeakDetected using deriv() when container memory grows steadily for 3 hours
output:
groups:
  - name: containers
    rules:
      - alert: MemoryLeakDetected
        expr: deriv(container_memory_working_set_bytes[3h]) > 100000
        for: 30m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: Possible memory leak in {{ $labels.container }}
          description: Container {{ $labels.container }} memory has been growing steadily for 3 hours.

instruction: Write an alert rule named JobFailed that fires when a Kubernetes job reports a failure
output:
groups:
  - name: kubernetes
    rules:
      - alert: JobFailed
        expr: kube_job_status_failed > 0
        for: 0m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: Job {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.job_name }} failed
          description: The job reported at least one failed pod.

instruction: Write a multiwindow SLO alert rule named FastErrorBudgetBurn firing on fast burn of the error budget
output:
groups:
  - name: slo
    rules:
      - alert: FastErrorBudgetBurn
        expr: (job:http_request_errors:rate5m / job:http_requests:rate5m > 14.4 * 0.001) and (job:http_request_errors:rate1h / job:http_requests:rate1h > 14.4 * 0.001)
        for: 2m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: Fast error budget burn on {{ $labels.job }}
          description: The error budget for {{ $labels.job }} is being consumed 14.4 times faster than allowed.

instruction: Write an alert rule named BlackboxProbeFailed firing when an HTTP probe fails for 5 minutes
output:
groups:
  - name: blackbox
    rules:
      - alert: BlackboxProbeFailed
        expr: probe_success == 0
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: Probe failed for {{ $labels.instance }}
          description: The blackbox exporter cannot reach {{ $labels.instance }} for 5 minutes.

instruction: Write an alert rule named HighScrapeDuration firing when a scrape takes longer than 8 seconds
output:
groups:
  - name: scrape
    rules:
      - alert: HighScrapeDuration
        expr: scrape_duration_seconds > 8
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: Slow scrape of {{ $labels.job }} on {{ $labels.instance }}
          description: Scraping {{ $labels.instance }} has taken more than 8 seconds for 10 minutes.
